metadata.purpose: Full SHT FFT-target layout pilot with the paired-outer helper module declared after the existing f64 complex kernels
metadata.workload: All current exact C2C and real SHT target operation/length cells; one-transform and scalar/spin-1 row batches; one transform thread
metadata.timing: Three alternating process pairs; seven warmed samples per operation
metadata.compiler: Rust 1.99.0 stable; optimized bench profile; portable x86_64 target; runtime AVX2 dispatch
metadata.cpu_model: AMD Ryzen 9 5950X; process pinned to logical CPU 30
metadata.dispatch_note: The f64 N=1442 radix-103 AVX2 pass uses an out-of-line paired-outer kernel for even groups and a scalar tail for odd groups.
metadata.runner: run_m24_clean_capture.py records process IDs, uptime, and load averages before, during, and after each run, and fsyncs every JSONL record.
